name: Form
summary: Semantic form wrapper with dual-mode validation. Native mode (v0.6) is the default — manual `validate` callback, blur-validation, focus-on-first-error. RHF mode (v0.7) activates when a Zod `schema` prop is passed — wraps children in a FormProvider, auto-registers nested Fields by `name`, and surfaces field-level errors automatically.

onSubmit.description: Called with the validated payload. Native mode: receives FormData. RHF mode: receives the typed schema-inferred object.

onError.description: Called when submit is blocked by validation. RHF mode: receives the FieldErrors map from react-hook-form.

validate.description: (formData) => Record<fieldName, error>. Native mode only. Called on submit; return non-empty record to block. Ignored when `schema` is set.

schema.description: Zod schema. When present, activates RHF mode: the form internally calls useForm({ resolver: zodResolver(schema) }) and wraps children in FormProvider.

defaultValues.description: RHF mode only. Initial values for all registered fields. Recommended whenever `schema` is set so RHF stays in controlled-friendly mode from first render.

resolver.description: RHF mode only. Override resolver. Defaults to zodResolver(schema). Pass a custom resolver to swap validation engines (yup, valibot, etc.).

mode.description: RHF mode only. When validation runs. Default `onBlur` matches the Lumen validation timing rule (validate on blur after first interaction).

density.description: Sets data-density on the form root; nested .lumen-field shells respect it.

children.description: Field, Fieldset, ValidationMessage, and submit Button.

keyboard: Tab — move through fields in DOM order
Enter — submit (when focus is in a single-line input)
Ctrl+Enter / Cmd+Enter — submit (when focus is in a textarea)
rules: On submit failure, focus moves to the first invalid field. RHF mode does this automatically via shouldFocusError; native mode does it via the focus-on-first-error orchestration.
On submit failure, render a ValidationMessage summary at the top of the form with anchor links to each invalid field.
Submit button disabled state must NEVER be the only signal of validation failure — the user must be able to attempt submit and see what's wrong.
Live region for server validation errors uses aria-live=polite by default; assertive only for critical errors that need immediate attention.
When using `schema` prop, Zod validation errors auto-bind to fields via FormProvider. Manual `error` prop on Field is overridden when RHF is active.

do: Validate on blur after first interaction; switch to onChange after first error per field.
On submit, validate everything — focus the first invalid field, render a summary at top.
Pair Form with Field — let Field own field-level UI; Form owns flow + submit + summary.
Set autoComplete='off' only for sensitive forms (one-time passcode entry); default keep on.
Use `schema` for any non-trivial form (>3 fields). Native Form is for simple cases.
Pair with `<Field name="email">` — the `name` prop bridges Field to RHF's register/control.
dont: Don't disable the submit button as the only signal of failed validation — the user should be able to submit and see errors.
Don't validate on every keystroke before first interaction — wait for blur.
Don't suppress browser autofill for known-safe fields (name, email, address). Autofill is an a11y feature.
Don't mix manual `validate` prop with `schema` — pick one. RHF + Zod is canonical for non-trivial forms; the `validate` callback is ignored in RHF mode.
Don't paint your own error state on Field when RHF is active — let `formState.errors` drive the message via the FieldRHFBridge.

changelog.note: react-hook-form binding via FormProvider + zodResolver. Pass `schema` (Zod) and `defaultValues`; nested `<Field name="…">` auto-registers and surfaces field errors.
Initial release. Lightweight native FormElement wrapper with onSubmit, validate, focus-on-first-error orchestration, and a density mode hook. v0.7 adds react-hook-form binding.
